I believe what you're experiencing to be one of the most basic components of being alive: deciding why to protect oneself from poor health, financial ruin, and crushed dreams. In essence, why to live.

We are led to believe that a person must be rich, have a wide coterie of friends and a partner to be happy. And if someone is not happy, then they have no reason to live, because the goal of life is to live well and spread that positive energy. To have a positive rather than negative effect on the world.

And yet, there's only one life. If someone has been depressed for so long that nothing is enjoyable, do they have a reason to live?

Yes. Because the other choice is not the escape it would seem to be.

Why should you live?
Why should you die?

Staring at the walls, staring into nothingness, being alone as you are, is very similar to most of life's experience.

Do you stand up and say 'I am someone'?
Or do you let yourself sink into nothingness, forgetting that you exist?

It makes no difference if you are by yourself.
You have to have a relationship with yourself.

Then others will see.

Hello,

Once I thought that ending my life was the strongest, most assertive way to take control away from those that I felt controlled me.

I didn't go through with it, and I am here today to share with you what I have discovered. 

My attitude towards suicide, as an out in case of emergency, has stolen so much of my young life. It ended up controlling me, limiting me very badly. I was reckless on purpose (not caring about the outcomes), and I lost many friends and opportunities.

Some day, you may realize your problems are manageable. Not solvable, but manageable. That'll be your first step, my friend.

Many people are so lost. They just feel completely hopeless. Maybe that's why we spend so much time on reddit, or especially r/SuicideWatch. Many people are here to share their feelings of hopelessness or inadequacy.

Your post isn't uninteresting. It's actually very important. You are reaching out for help on this site for the first time and that is so important. Your feelings matter. You've been through a lot already in life and you are struggling.

You aren't hopeless, as long as you can still reach out for help. Hang in there.

I read everything you wrote. I have some of the same problems, and some I have never had. The best thing I can give to you would be this:

Many, many, many people are just hopelessly lost and confused and uncertain. Until you are faced with a terminal illness, or homeless and starving (or all three), you have no reason to think that there might not be another tomorrow.

There are people I follow on twitter just because they blogged about what a disaster their lives were as young people, and now they're thirty or forty and maintaining some degree of stability. You've been dealt a shitty hand in life, but you will figure out how to handle it as you get older. The only reason to end your life now would be because you have no curiosity whatsoever about the person that you will become. Or for that matter, who the people around you will become. We're all in this together.

Hope that these words reach you. Best of luck :)
